context: Two friends chat about an outing
purpose: Teach: 薪/館内/本館/防音/農作業/手洗い/補習/弾ける

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お土産屋で、薪のミニチュア、買った。
lines.en: I bought a little wooden firewood sculpture at the gift shop.
lines.style: Light, pleased discovery. Quick rhythm, bright attack on the opening. The delight of a small find shared casually. No weight to it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。美術館の館内、写真撮影、禁止だった。
lines.en: Yeah. We couldn't take photos inside the museum galleries.
lines.style: Acknowledgment with a small sigh underneath. Accepting the constraint without resentment. Warm agreement, slightly wistful about the photos they didn't get.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本館の入り口、装飾、豪華だったね。
lines.en: The main entrance was really elaborately decorated, wasn't it?
lines.style: Genuine wonder in the voice. Leans forward slightly. The enthusiasm of someone noticing something beautiful and wanting to name it together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カフェ、防音壁、設置したの、よかった。
lines.en: I'm glad they put in the soundproof wall in the café.
lines.style: Satisfied and warm. A small nod in the voice — approval of good planning. Practical relief mixed with genuine care for the quiet space.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 実家、夏は、農作業の手伝い、頼まれる。
lines.en: My family asks me to help with farm work every summer back home.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia. Slower pace. There's affection in the complaint, the weight of obligation and belonging mixed together. Quiet acceptance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 手洗い、しっかりしてね、コロナ対策。
lines.en: Make sure you wash your hands properly, just to be safe.
lines.style: Practical care without fussing. Matter-of-fact tone but genuine concern underneath. The way you give small advice to someone you look out for.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 子供たち、夏休み、補習続いてるみたい。
lines.en: The kids still have to keep going to summer remedial classes.
lines.style: Soft observation. A slight shake of the head in the voice — sympathy for them and their parents both. Not complaining, just noting the weight of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: シャンパン、コルクが弾ける音、気持ちいいよね。
lines.en: There's something so satisfying about the pop of a champagne cork.
lines.style: Warm, almost dreamy. Softens on the middle words. Inviting you to feel it too. A gentle close — comfort found in small, shared pleasures.
